setup_missing: This version of the Lark gateway has no personal agents. Update the Lark gateway and try again.
setup_disabled: The extension that provides personal agents has not turned them on: turn them on as its guide says, then restart
setup_no_accounts: No personal agent accounts connected yet: add Cue or Grok Bot in the Lark gateway's settings
removed_toast: Removed “{title}”. It comes back when it gets a new message.
removed_footer: Removed chats stay in the Lark gateway and come back on their own when a new message arrives.
